10378|6bdb24d7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|6bdb24d7.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

10668|0ff05fae.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|0ff05fae.text:
The body is that of a female $r $c.

It is clear that she died in battle, probably against the quilboar in the area.

10668|aa4f9f41.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|aa4f9f41.text:
You turn the body over and see the marks from blades and spells upon the deceased $r--her armor all but destroyed, her hair matted to her face.

Based on Mankrik's description of her, there is no doubt in your mind that this was his wife.

He will be upset by the news, but you are sure he should know the truth.

11017|8ad376c5.name: Roxxik
11017|8ad376c5.text: Nice going! I knew I was right about you, no matter what those other people said. Ha! I'm kidding! Okay, on with your lessons...

11066|b615098a.name: Jhag
11066|b615098a.text: To die in battle is glorious! But, with what I teach you, maybe you not die so quickly, hm?

11833|eb2e4319.name: Rahauro
11833|eb2e4319.text:
Well met, $c. You may speak to me unless you have direct business with my mistress Magatha.

I deal with most of her tasks for her so she can concentrate on more important matters. Perhaps there are some things we could discuss before you seek audience with her?

14729|9e055276.name: Ralston Farnsley
14729|9e055276.text:
You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.

We currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

1495|54c6960c.name: Deathguard Linnea
1495|54c6960c.text: Greetings, $C. Be wary as you travel east toward The Bulwark. Recent surveillance reports indicate increased Scourge activity in that area, so exercise caution.

1499|9cb5b422.name: Magistrate Sevren
1499|9cb5b422.text: Ah, you there!  I have tasks to give, and I need not waste time explaining their crucial nature.  Listen close.

1500|2af9e51a.name: Coleman Farthing
1500|2af9e51a.text:
I hope you're well, all things considered.

Sit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2128|7d510daf.name: Cain Firesong
2128|7d510daf.text: Greetings.  I'm an $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

261371|c0c247fc.name: Vrang Wildgore
261371|c0c247fc.text:
Those humans got what they deserved. 

<Vrang spits on the ground.>

267009|6f316d7a.name: Hadric Harlson
267009|6f316d7a.text: Be careful, $c. There are cultists nearby.

2855|8f48a40a.name: Snang
2855|8f48a40a.text: I know a few things, but I'm no expert. Lucky for you, Magar is. He's standing near the back of the shop. See if he can help you, but be careful not to rile him. He can be irritable.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3142|99ae9589.name: Orgnil Soulscar
3142|99ae9589.text: Hail.  Be brief, for we both have much to do.

3188|366172e1.name: Master Gadrin
3188|366172e1.text: There is something you wish to discuss, $c... come, sit by me.

3216|13f1d3f9.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|13f1d3f9.text:
Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.

Our great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

3216|1672ee12.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|1672ee12.text:
Naive fool. The Burning Blade IS the Shadow Council! There are many cults and organizations under the Council's rule, but all of them are just extensions of their will. I may lead the Burning Blade, but I am still just as much a pawn to the Council as you are to me!

Look at the Searing Blade--most of them think they are becoming the next rising group of powerful warlocks that they will replace the Shadow Council.

3216|2e9c14b6.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|2e9c14b6.text: Haha! Save for their leaders--the satyr, Bazzalan, and the warlock Jergosh--yes, all of them. That is why I constantly send Thrall's worshippers at them. It gives Thrall the impression that I am weeding out the evil in the bowels of his great city. The victory is in reality two-fold: kill Thrall's faithful and test the strength of those in the Searing Blade to see if they are truly worthy of joining me.

3216|9353e287.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|9353e287.text:
Ah, one of our own. It is good to see our numbers are growing so rapidly that I can no longer keep track of the faces of our members.

That fool Thrall thinks I am working hard to cleanse the image of warlocks and prove we are his servants. Idiot! The Burning Legion will make ash of this entire world after it drains it completely.

3216|e0c203bc.name: Neeru Fireblade
3216|e0c203bc.text: I will make it known to you. You are obviously already proving yourself in our ranks to become a lieutenant so quickly. Perhaps you can return to me later and I will have tasks for you. The council adores those skilled in the arcane, but servants of all kinds are always welcome, no matter their profession.

3296|c0e82349.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|c0e82349.text: Go to the cleft of shadow and seek out Spellweaver Mon'ye there, near the center of the district.

3296|c407ea01.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|c407ea01.text: Speak to Pephredo at the Darkbriar Lodge in the Valley of Spirits, up above and to the west of the Valley of Strength.

3296|d35cf9cb.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|d35cf9cb.text: You want the Hall of Legends. It's high above the Valley of Strength on the west side. If you're not an officer you can't get in, but you can still talk to Sergeant Ba'sha outside.

3304|645294fc.name: Master Vornal
3304|645294fc.text: The sands of Durotar are tough and dry compared to the tropical and lush lands we're from, but we Darkspear persevere. Where chief Vol'jin leads, we will follow.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3320|6b36598f.name: Soran
3320|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3320|ae78a458.name: Soran
3320|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3338|e2ff6310.name: Sergra Darkthorn
3338|e2ff6310.text: The land, the water, and the sky are all as one. It is your eyes that deceive you with such separation. The Earthmother is all those things and more.

3353|640f312b.name: Grezz Ragefist
3353|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

3354|640f312b.name: Sorek
3354|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

3373|1355f2b7.name: Arnok
3373|1355f2b7.text: I am an $r of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3387|da8a5dad.name: Jorn Skyseer
3387|da8a5dad.text: Although we call this land the Barrens, to one who knows where to look this place teems with life.

3389|5612724d.name: Regthar Deathgate
3389|5612724d.text: We have our duties, $c.  Duties to the Horde.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3412|3ec49d32.name: Nogg
3412|3ec49d32.text: You have earned the privilege of training with a higher instructor. Go see my pal Roxxik there.

3412|fe9433e2.name: Nogg
3412|fe9433e2.text: Every day is a test, and this day is no different. If you pass this test, I will share some of my knowledge...

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3433|ac5dfa0b.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|ac5dfa0b.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and $r cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3549|2cec462d.name: Shelene Rhobart
3549|2cec462d.text: Skin, glorious skin. It holds your insides... in. You might've noticed my skin's not doing so well. To think I used to worry about my pores. Hardly any skin left to worry about these days. In a way, it's very freeing.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3682|960c6ca2.name: Vrang Wildgore
3682|960c6ca2.text: Are you in need of a weapon, traveler? You'll not find a finer blade anywhere, I assure you.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4568|7d510daf.name: Anastasia Hartwell
4568|7d510daf.text: Greetings.  I'm an $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

4949|9255c79c.name: Thrall
4949|9255c79c.text:
It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the Shadow Council. No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the Burning Blade, the Argus Wake, and the Searing Blade are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same.

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5769|c9ae2675.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
5769|c9ae2675.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

5883|f341dff7.name: Enyo
5883|f341dff7.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6791|60c5da07.name: Innkeeper Wiley
6791|60c5da07.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

6929|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Gryshka
6929|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

1130-accept.name: Jorn Skyseer
1130-accept.text:
$N, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you.

If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor.  You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
1130-accept.title: Melor Sends Word

1486-accept.name: Nalpak
1486-accept.text:
As Naralex descended deeper into his nightmare, a strange breed of beasts arose from beneath the Barrens into the Wailing Caverns.

These deviate creatures have strange, otherworldly properties. While evil in nature, it is my opinion that some good can come from their existence here in Kalimdor. I believe their hides will be of particular use in the ways of leatherworking.

If you feel up to the task, venture into the caves below and retrieve some deviate hides.
1486-accept.title: Deviate Hides

1487-accept.name: Ebru
1487-accept.text:
Naralex had a noble goal.

Our great leader aspired to enter the Emerald Dream and help regrow these harsh lands back into the lush forest it once was. But something went terribly wrong.

Naralex's dream turned into a nightmare and corrupt creatures began to inhabit the caverns.

While some Disciples of Naralex seek to awake our master, my concern is with ridding these caves of the evil beasts.

Brave the caverns, $N, and eradicate the deviate spawn.
1487-accept.title: Deviate Eradication

1489-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
1489-accept.text:
The shells you brought me have a taint, one I have never before seen.  I am certain the water of the Oases is the cause, and I can sense the confusion they cause this land.  It is as if the land dreams and cannot awake.

The Wailing Caverns must be the source of the taint.  But before you go there, speak with Hamuul Runetotem, the elder druid.  I sent word to him of the happenings in the Barrens.  He is wise, and can offer you counsel.

You will find him in Thunder Bluff, on the Elder Rise.
1489-accept.title: Hamuul Runetotem

1489-complete.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
1489-complete.text: I bid you greetings, $N.  You are welcome here, and I suggest you gather all your strength.  For the task we now set before you ... is a dire one.
1489-complete.title: Hamuul Runetotem

1490-accept.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
1490-accept.text:
I entered the land of dreams, and dreamed of a cult of druids who dwell in the Wailing Caverns.  I saw that their goals were once noble, but they have lost their way.  They are now servants of the taint seeping through the Barrens.

I am old and my strength fails.  I could not long dwell in that dreaming place and know little more of the tainted druids.  But Nara is young and her spirit is fierce.  She remained in the dreaming when I fled.

Speak with Nara.  She is in the tent, over yonder.
1490-accept.title: Nara Wildmane

1490-complete.name: Nara Wildmane
1490-complete.text:
Yes, it is true.  I know of the druids in the Wailing Caverns.  I have seen their twisted, scaled faces.  I know their crimes, and I know their plans.

You must stop them, $N.
1490-complete.title: Nara Wildmane

1491-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1491-accept.text:
Ok, so the raptor horns didn't work so well.  But that's all right -- no one got rich on their first try!  And besides, I think I found something that'll work even better in my smart drinks!

There is a substance called Wailing Essence, and I think it is the cause of the strange plants and animals in the Barrens.  Get me some and I'll try it in my drink!

I heard the essence gathers in ectoplasmic creatures in the Wailing Caverns to the west.  Hunt those creatures and gather the essence.
1491-accept.title: Smart Drinks

1881-complete.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1881-complete.text: Greetings, $N.  You were wise to answer my call, and wiser still if you heed what I next say...
1881-complete.title: Speak with Anastasia

1882-accept.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1882-accept.text:
The Plaguelands to the east are an aberration.  Devised by the Lich King, they spread their magic into the soil, corrupting and killing all that live.  Although there is a certain charm to the destructive forces of the plague, we, the mages of the Forsaken, believe it is unruly and must be curtailed.

But first, we must measure how far it has spread into Tirisfal.  Go to the Balnir Farmstead in eastern Tirisfal.  In the garden are flowers--snapdragons.  Gather these and return.
1882-accept.title: The Balnir Farmstead

1882-complete.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1882-complete.text:
Ah, a fine specimen this is.  I will send it to be studied by our apothecaries to determine the extent of the Plagueland's taint.

Well done, $N.  For your services, I present to you this choice: an orb or staff.  Whichever you choose, you will find it quite useful.
1882-complete.title: The Balnir Farmstead

1882-progress.name: Anastasia Hartwell
1882-progress.text: Do you have the snapdragons?  That breed of flower is highly receptive to magic energies, and studying the snapdragons so close to the Plaguelands can tell us if the plague has entered Tirisfal Glades.
1882-progress.title: The Balnir Farmstead

264-accept.name: Clarice Foster
264-accept.text:
Filthy scum! Leaves me for his damn crusade. Because "the Light is the most important thing we have against the threats the undead pose."

Well, what about his children?! What about ME?! Night after night I sat patiently waiting for him... always second to his blasted duty!

Well, witness what "justice" brings you, $N! He's dead and I'm bearing the very thing he was trying to stop!

Take this piece of junk and put it on his tomb at the Sepulcher. I want nothing to do with it anymore... or him!
264-accept.title: Until Death Do Us Part

3261-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
3261-accept.text: Your time with me is over, $N.  To learn more, you must go to Camp Taurajo to the south and speak with Jorn Skyseer.  He will continue your guidance.
3261-accept.title: Jorn Skyseer

3281-complete.name: Gazrog
3281-complete.text:
Aha!  So the raptors did hide the silver at their lair.  It's hard to believe these beasts would have the desire for silver.  Perhaps the stories of their intelligence are not as far from the mark as I thought!

Thank you, $N.  Take this as a reward for your service to us, and know that the guards of the crossroads owe their next month's pay to you.
3281-complete.title: Stolen Silver

3513-accept.name: Unknown
3513-accept.text:
The official-looking scroll is wrapped tightly with a silvery ribbon. You're sure someone would be interested in seeing this, but who?

There is an outpost close to the Ashenvale border to the north, and if the information on this scroll involves the night elves, this would be the place to take it.
3513-accept.title: The Runed Scroll

354-complete.name: Coleman Farthing
354-complete.text:
Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think?  When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them?  I hope so.  I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.

It is a foolish hope, I know.  But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.
354-complete.title: Deaths in the Family

354-progress.name: Coleman Farthing
354-progress.text: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
354-progress.title: Deaths in the Family

355-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
355-accept.text:
You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge.  But the Agamand Mills hold a threat to all the Forsaken, not just to me.

I have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.
355-accept.title: Speak with Sevren

355-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
355-complete.text:
Coleman speaks well of you, $N, telling of your successful forays into the Agamand Mills.

The Forsaken have need of your talents once again...
355-complete.title: Speak with Sevren

356-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-complete.text: Very good. Your efforts do much to keep the Scourge at bay. A commendation will be sent to my superior, Executor Zygand.
356-complete.title: Rear Guard Patrol

357-accept.name: Bethor Iceshard
357-accept.text:
There is a lich who dwells on the island in Brightwater Lake to the north.  Although he is a free-willed Forsaken, he believes all other $R are Scourge slaves and has his minions attack anyone who approaches him.

But because he is Forsaken, the Queen will want him.  And if he is skilled in Necromancy, then his knowledge would be...quite useful to us.

To discover his identity and his talents, I must see his spellbook.  Steal into his camp and acquire it, then return to me.
357-accept.title: The Lich's Identity

357-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
357-complete.text:
Very good, $N.  I will study this book and determine the identity of that lich.  You have served your Queen well.

<Bethor opens the book and stares intently at its glowing pages...>

Astonishing!  The book you retrieved belongs to no one other than Gunther Arcanus!

Gunther was a skilled Necromancer in life; he and I were friends and comrades-in-arms, before the Plague.  And judging from his book he has grown even more powerful in death.

His skills would be a great boon to us.
357-complete.title: The Lich's Identity

358-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-complete.text:
Expertly done, $N.  The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by our Apothecaries.  It may have secrets we can use against them.

As I said, well done.  But our struggle continues, and the conflict will surely offer you more chances to prove your worth to the Forsaken.
358-complete.title: Graverobbers

358-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-progress.text: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
358-progress.title: Graverobbers

359-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
359-accept.text:
I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east.

I must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal.  Our vigilance on the border to the Plaguelands must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here!

Travel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation.  Speak with Deathguard Linnea.  She has the information I need.
359-accept.title: Forsaken Duties

359-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
359-complete.text:
Magistrate Sevren wants a report?  Very well: the defenders at The Bulwark are holding the majority of the Scourge at bay, but some do slip through on occasion.

We have seen sporadic Scourge activity east of this station, with a concentration around the Balnir Farmstead.
359-complete.title: Forsaken Duties

360-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
360-accept.text:
Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you.  He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.

And if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.
360-accept.title: Return to the Magistrate

360-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
360-complete.text:
It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark.  The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.

But we will not give in.  He will not take us again!
360-complete.title: Return to the Magistrate

362-complete.name: Coleman Farthing
362-complete.text:
Thank you.  Devlin's bones will rest nicely on my mantle.

If my cold heart can find warmth, it is in knowing that the Agamands are destroyed.  They failed me and my family when the Plague came - now I swear I will smash their remains under my heel!
362-complete.title: The Haunted Mills

366-accept.name: Bethor Iceshard
366-accept.text:
Long ago Gunther and I, along with the now Scourge Necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, were friends and students within the Kirin Tor - a society of mages in Dalaran.

Gunther and I both fell to the Plague, but I thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King.  It is good to know he is free.

We must have him.  I have placed a spell on his book that, when he sees it, will show him that I too am free of the Lich King.  After knowing this, it is my hope that he will join us.
366-accept.title: Return the Book

368-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-complete.text: The scales are perfect, $N. Exactly what I needed for this concoction.
368-complete.title: A New Plague

368-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-progress.text: $N, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?
368-progress.title: A New Plague

369-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-accept.text:
While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims.  Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.

Bring me some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to complete this experiment.  I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction.  Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern Tirisfal Glades.
369-accept.title: A New Plague

369-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-complete.text: Ah, this venom will do perfectly, $N.  Everything else has been added to my concoction and boiled down.  Finally, I am ready to try this new deadly agent!
369-complete.title: A New Plague

369-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-progress.text: Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, $N?  It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.
369-progress.title: A New Plague

371-complete.name: Executor Zygand
371-complete.text: Captain Vachon's death will slow down the Scarlet Crusade's advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit.  But other threats loom.
371-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

372-accept.name: Executor Zygand
372-accept.text:
Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest.  According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named Captain Melrache is in charge of this evil crew.

I am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission.  Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.
372-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

374-complete.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-complete.text: Varimathras would be proud.  You serve your leaders well, $c.
374-complete.title: Proof of Demise

374-progress.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-progress.text: Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, $c?
374-progress.title: Proof of Demise

3921-accept.name: Sputtervalve
3921-accept.text:
I think I might have broken that Samophlange.  That's not good, because I already told some colleagues in Undermine about it and they were very intrigued.  We must find a way to fix it!

Take the broken samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket, just south of Mor'shan Rampart, the horde outpost between the Barrens and Ashenvale.  She is very clever and inquisitive.  If you show her the samophlange I bet she'd jump at the chance to fix it.
3921-accept.title: Wenikee Boltbucket

398-complete.name: Executor Zygand
398-complete.text: Maggot Eye's dastardly acts have finally been avenged.  Maybe your acts of valor will send a clear message to those who wish to bring harm to our people.  On behalf of the town of Brill I thank you, $N.
398-complete.title: WANTED: Maggot Eye

4021-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
4021-accept.text:
The Horde commends your successes against the Kolkar, but the Kolkar themselves are maddened.  I have reports that a contingent of Kolkar has traveled to the Barrens from their home in Desolace, to seek vengeance.  My latest report was that, even now, they move against these bunkers, from the west!

Face the Kolkar invaders, and end their threat in the Barrens.  Kill them until their leader, Warlord Krom'zar, appears.  Defeat him and bring me a piece of his banner as proof.

We're counting on you, $N.
4021-accept.title: Counterattack!

405-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
405-accept.text:
Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful $c in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge.  You, $N, will be that agent.

Present these orders to Bethor.  He will then instruct you on your mission.  I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich.  And it will be dangerous.

So ready yourself, $C.  You must not fail.

You may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
405-accept.title: The Prodigal Lich

405-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-complete.text:
Ah, you are the agent sent by Magistrate Sevren.  Then yes, your business with me is crucial.

I trust Sevren has mustered someone suitable for my task...but we shall see.
405-complete.title: The Prodigal Lich

405-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-progress.text:
Greetings.  Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
405-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich

408-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-accept.text:
The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge.  Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered.  With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.

This cannot pass, and you must stop it.  Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.

And, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.
408-accept.title: The Family Crypt

408-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-progress.text: Time is not a luxury we have, $N.  With each passing hour, the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal Glades grows more firm.
408-progress.title: The Family Crypt

426-complete.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-complete.text: Your efforts in the war are felt among us, $N.  I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but the Deathguards of Tirisfal will remember your name.
426-complete.title: The Mills Overrun

426-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-progress.text: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, $N.  Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless $r back into the Plaguelands!
426-progress.title: The Mills Overrun

492-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
492-accept.text:
According to the Deathguard, another one of those foolish Dwarven Mountaineers has just been captured.  The Deathguard likes to use the cellar of the Gallows End Tavern as a holding cell until prisoners can be "properly" dealt with.

Why don't you go see how the Captured Mountaineer enjoys this special drink I made for him?  It contains a subtle hint of what The Dark Lady has planned for the rest of Azeroth.
492-accept.title: A New Plague

492-complete.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-complete.text: Ah, a drink at last.  I'm sure it's no Rhapsody Malt but I'll take anything to whet the old whistle at this point.
492-complete.title: A New Plague

492-progress.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-progress.text: Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, $C.  Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!
492-progress.title: A New Plague

4921-accept.name: Mankrik
4921-accept.text:
We battled in a small tauren camp when we were separated--she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. But the odds began to overwhelm us. I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.

I awoke to a tauren druid tending my wounds--he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.

Please, $c, find some sign of my wife.
4921-accept.title: Lost in Battle

5041-complete.name: Thork
5041-complete.text: Haha! Thank you, $N! This will help us greatly. You're a boon to the Crossroads and to the Horde. If there is anything I can do for you, please, let me know.
5041-complete.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5041-progress.name: Thork
5041-progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
5041-progress.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5482-complete.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-complete.text:
Ah, my doom weed. Excellent!

<Junior Apothecary Holland rubs his hands together greedily.>

These will come in quite handy. You've done me, uh, the Lady, a fine service today, $N. As promised here is the reward that you deserve.
5482-complete.title: Doom Weed

5482-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-progress.text: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
5482-progress.title: Doom Weed

5722-accept.name: Rahauro
5722-accept.text:
The troggs are not the only thing that interested Magatha in Ragefire Chasm. She has heard word that one of her servants, a Maur Grimtotem, found something peculiar while in the Chasm, but he never made it out to show her what. She'd like Maur's body found--if it still exists--and any signs of what he found while attempting to speak to the troggs.

Return to Magatha any items of interest, and I'm sure she would be very generous in her reward.

Again, seek the Chasm in the darkest areas of Orgrimmar.
5722-accept.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

5722-complete.name: Unknown
5722-complete.text:
The body looks seriously beaten by clubs or fists, but most of the corpse's clothing and equipment still looks present. It seems the troggs do not overly care much for material wealth.

You begin to search the body for anything of interest that might help Magatha.
5722-complete.title: Searching for the Lost Satchel

5723-accept.name: Rahauro
5723-accept.text:
Beneath the city of Orgrimmar, stout creatures known as troggs started coming to the surface from deep below the lava filled tunnels. In her ever-benevolence, Magatha sought to make peace with the creatures, but they turned on her diplomats, killing them. She will not allow such treatment of the tauren people and now consider the creatures a threat to all of the Horde.

She asks that you put an end to this trogg threat before it overwhelms the Horde from below. Find Ragefire Chasm and destroy them all.
5723-accept.title: Testing an Enemy's Strength

5724-accept.name: Unknown
5724-accept.text:
You find a satchel under the body of the tauren. It is still gripped tightly in his arms as though he was trying to protect it while being attacked by the troggs.

Removing the satchel from his vice-like grip, you stow it with your own equipment and prepare to make your way out of the tunnels and back to Rahauro in Thunder Bluff.
5724-accept.title: Returning the Lost Satchel

5725-accept.name: Varimathras
5725-accept.text:
Many denizens of the Legion bestow gifts on their followers as you may well know. Some of these gifts the Dark Lady feels would be better off in her hands than in the hands of those with... lesser vision.

A sect of the Shadow Council hidden in caverns below Orgrimmar known as the Searing Blade are a prime example. The Lady tells me that members of the Searing Blade have come into the possession of two powerful spell books--she would like to "borrow" these books from them. You will get them for her.
5725-accept.title: The Power to Destroy...

5726-accept.name: Thrall
5726-accept.text:
One thing I will not tolerate are traitors in our midst, $N. But I would be a fool to play my hand so early--it would not sufficiently cut the corruption out of our lands and only cause the infection to grow worse.

But you, a young adventurer, could go places my agents could not... could learn the truth... could find the true head of the beast.

If you are brave enough, then enter Skull Rock to the east of Orgrimmar, find a lieutenant's insignia off one of the Burning Blade there, and return to me.
5726-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5726-complete.name: Thrall
5726-complete.text:
Good, $N! The spirits be praised, perhaps you are the one who will finally put my greatest fears to rest! Who would suspect someone so young and so brave would rise up and champion our cause? You remind me of myself when I was younger. I will ensure that you are justly rewarded for your efforts if we both survive the coming storm.

But there is time for more praise later. You've not accomplished anything in comparison to what you will face... but this is a good start.
5726-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5726-progress.name: Thrall
5726-progress.text:
Do you have the insignia yet, $N?

It will be a vital tool in infiltrating what I believe is the greatest threat to the Horde, and finally finding peace in our new home.

You will learn how intricate a web men and orcs alike can weave when they are motivated by greed and power. The hidden agendas, the corruption, all of it will become clear. You will find yourself in the midst of a war you never knew existed.
5726-progress.title: Hidden Enemies

5727-accept.name: Thrall
5727-accept.text:
Now let us see if this insignia you found is worth the effort.

There is a warlock within the city who believes he has my trust. He does not know that I realize where his true loyalties lie. He is in fact the leader of the Burning Blade. But do not rush off to do battle with him; he has a purpose, and we shall use him against our enemies.

Take this insignia to him in the Cleft of Shadow here in Orgrimmar, speak to him and see if he believes you are one of his own, then return to me here.
5727-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5727-complete.name: Thrall
5727-complete.text:
Excellent! Most excellent, $c!

What you have done this day is only the first step in a much broader foundation--a foundation that we will build the destruction of the Shadow Council on, once and for all.

Tell me all he said... and leave not one word out--it may be more important than you realize.
5727-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5728-accept.name: Thrall
5728-accept.text:
Hmm, leaders of the Searing Blade... this concerns me most. If they are the ones of value to Neeru, then those are who we must target first. This satyr... Bazzalan, and the other Neeru mentioned--what was he, a warlock?--must be slain.

Return to the Cleft of Shadow and enter Ragefire Chasm, $N. Find these two leaders of the Searing Blade, and kill them. But be careful not to let Neeru know it was you who did this. You must retain your identity as one of his brothers in arms.
5728-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5728-complete.name: Thrall
5728-complete.text: I am glad you've returned, $N. Some of those loyal to me brought word immediately that the caverns below Orgrimmar were in disarray now that their leaders have been slain. I even heard reports that Neeru was more than agitated. It seems we've put a dent in his armor. I can't say I'm displeased... even with such a minor victory.
5728-complete.title: Hidden Enemies

5729-accept.name: Thrall
5729-accept.text:
I think our next step should be to have you placed close to Neeru. If he is as agitated as reports suggest, then we may accomplish two things. One, you may be able to gain some greater knowledge about the Council or at least the Burning Blade, and two, he may just begin to trust you enough that he asks you to start to aid him. He may very well look at you as someone who can fill the void now that some of the leadership is in turmoil.

Return to the Cleft and speak to him again, but do not be too overt.
5729-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

5761-accept.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-accept.text:
The primary task set upon me by our great Warchief is to root out the creatures responsible for infesting our lord's great city with demonic influence. The Burning Blade is one threat, but there are others; the Searing Blade for instance, who make their home in Ragefire Chasm, secretly attempting to subvert innocent members of the Horde.

If they are to be stopped, then their leader must be slain--a Felguard named Taragaman the Hungerer.

Kill him, and his heart will appease Thrall, of this I'm sure.
5761-accept.title: Slaying the Beast

5761-complete.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-complete.text:
Ha! You've done it! Thrall will be so pleased.

I will ensure this heart is taken care of properly.

For now though, you must celebrate your victory. I will inform Thrall of your success.

Thank you for your aid, $c.
5761-complete.title: Slaying the Beast

5761-progress.name: Neeru Fireblade
5761-progress.text: Have you killed the beast? He surely must be the leader of the Searing Blade in Ragefire Chasm.
5761-progress.title: Slaying the Beast

806-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
806-accept.text:
We cannot allow the Burning Blade a foothold in Durotar!  We must destroy them before their evil festers!

I have undergone my own investigations and found that a Burning Blade warlock, the goblin Fizzle Darkstorm, has camped within Thunder Ridge to the northwest.  There he and his cultist minions spread chaos.

Find and defeat Fizzle, and bring me his dead claw!
806-accept.title: Dark Storms

806-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
806-complete.text:
Aha!  You got him!

You do your clan proud, $N.  And because of you, Durotar is free of one more agent of evil.
806-complete.title: Dark Storms

806-progress.name: Orgnil Soulscar
806-progress.text: Did you find Fizzle, $N?  He, and rest of the Burning Blade, must be scoured from our lands!
806-progress.title: Dark Storms

808-accept.name: Master Gadrin
808-accept.text:
I hear the voice of my brother, Minshina, calling to me in my dreams.

He was taken by Zalazane, the warlock on the Echo Isles to the east. And he is dead.

But death is not freedom for my brother. Minshina's spirit was trapped within his own skull by Zalazane's magics. In my dreams I see it with other skulls, in a circle of power on the largest Echo Isle. As long as it remains there my brother's soul is doomed.

Please, $N. Find the circle and retrieve Minshina's skull. Bring it to me.

Free him!
808-accept.title: Minshina's Skull

808-complete.name: Master Gadrin
808-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  You have saved Minshina.  You have saved my brother's spirit from slavery!
808-complete.title: Minshina's Skull

808-progress.name: Master Gadrin
808-progress.text: Do you have my brother's skull, $N?  Is he finally free?
808-progress.title: Minshina's Skull

809-accept.name: Neeru Fireblade
809-accept.text:
Since the last great war when the Burning Legion was defeated, I have searched for sources of demonic corruption in orc society.  The collar you brought me confirms my fears.

It belongs to the Burning Blade, a cult that rallies around an item of demonic power.  It is called the Demon Seed, and it resides in the Barrens atop Dreadmist Peak.  It must be destroyed!

Go to Far Watch Post, on the border of the Barrens to the west, and speak with my assistant, Ak'Zeloth.  He will direct you further.
809-accept.title: Ak'Zeloth

823-accept.name: Master Gadrin
823-accept.text:
We at Sen'jin Village are not without our own troubles, and we thank you for your aid.  But the news you bring regarding the Burning Blade could be trouble for everyone.

There is an orc stationed at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar, who polices Durotar from evils such as the Burning Blade!  Go to Orgnil and tell him of our plight, as well as your news from the Valley of Trials.  He will want to know these things.

Razor Hill lies to the north.
823-accept.title: Report to Orgnil

823-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
823-complete.text: Yes?  You have something to report?  Well then, let's have it!
823-complete.title: Report to Orgnil

826-accept.name: Master Gadrin
826-accept.text:
The witchdoctor Zalazane dwells on the Echo Isles to the east.  They are the isles we once called home.

From there he sends his trolls to the mainland, to hex our people and drag more of them under his sway.

He must be stopped.

Defeat Zalazane and his minions -- former Darkspear trolls, now lost to us.  Bring me his head and I will know his reign of evil is over.
826-accept.title: Zalazane

826-complete.name: Master Gadrin
826-complete.text:
With Zalazane gone, our tribe can again sleep in peace.

Thank you, $N.  The Darkspear tribe owes you much.  If you suffer from an ailment, visit my assistant Bom'bay, behind me.  His voodoo is strong...
826-complete.title: Zalazane

827-accept.name: Margoz
827-accept.text:
$N.  The Burning Blade has infested the cave east of Orgrimmar known as Skull Rock.  Inside that cave they perform vile rituals, and burn their own flesh with Searing Collars.

By wearing these collars, I believe the cultists attune themselves to demonic power.  But to confirm this, I must have a collection of the collars to study.

Go to Skull Rock and gather Searing Collars from the cultists you find there.  Bring them to me, and I will uncover their secrets.
827-accept.title: Skull Rock

827-complete.name: Margoz
827-complete.text: Good.  Hiding within these collars is the secret behind the Burning Blade.  And I will uncover that secret...
827-complete.title: Skull Rock

827-progress.name: Margoz
827-progress.text: Have you yet entered Skull Rock, $N?  Do you have the Searing Collars?
827-progress.title: Skull Rock

828-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
828-accept.text:
One of our Shamans, Margoz, knows more of the Burning Blade's corruption.  He speaks of a cave called Skull Rock in the mountains - just outside Orgrimmar! - that shelters a large band of Burning Blade cultists.

Before you go to Skull Rock speak with Margoz.  He is wise and his council is valued.

He is camped to the northeast, between the coast and Drygulch Ravine.

Follow his advice, but whatever Margoz says, $N, I still want you to crush those cultists!
828-accept.title: Margoz

828-complete.name: Margoz
828-complete.text:
Welcome, $N.  Word reached me of your coming, and of your exploits in Durotar.

You are a $c of growing skill and renown.

Stay on the pure path, and your future will be great indeed.
828-complete.title: Margoz

829-accept.name: Margoz
829-accept.text:
The Searing Collars you brought me are powerful, demonic implements.  Divining their origin is, I'm afraid, beyond my skills as a shaman.  We will need a warlock to study them.

Take a searing collar to Neeru Fireblade.  Although he is a skilled warlock, he professes to use his powers to thwart demons, and claims his research in the occult is benign.  Be that true or false, we may need his aid against the demonic cult in Durotar.

You may find Neeru in Orgrimmar in the Cleft of Shadow.
829-accept.title: Neeru Fireblade

829-complete.name: Neeru Fireblade
829-complete.text:
Ah, and where did you get this?  Good Margoz in Razor Hill sent you to me, did he?

Well, let me take a closer look...
829-complete.title: Neeru Fireblade

829-progress.name: Neeru Fireblade
829-progress.text: My most humble greetings, $c.  How might I help my $r brother today?
829-progress.title: Neeru Fireblade

832-accept.name: Unknown
832-accept.text:
<Words emanate from the pendant and into your mind.>

Gazz'uz?

Gazz'uz...report!

There is word of your discovery in Skull Rock.  You must prepare for an attack!

Gazz'uz, I order you to speak!  Speak or I will make sure Neeru Fireblade knows of your presence, and he will descend on you with swift brutality.

Do not test your skills against Neeru...

...Gazz'uz, are you there...?
832-accept.title: Burning Shadows

832-complete.name: Neeru Fireblade
832-complete.text:
<Examines the Eye of Burning Shadow.>

Intriguing.  The voice you heard mentioned my name?  I am known for hunting down enemies of our Warchief, but...it is strange that I was singled out.  Stranger still that the Burning Blade cultists from whom you recovered this pendant have a name so close to my own.

I must study this pendant.  I must study and, and must ponder the meaning of its message.

Thank you for bringing this to my attention, $N.  You have done your people a great service.
832-complete.title: Burning Shadows

832-progress.name: Neeru Fireblade
832-progress.text: You have something vital to report.  I can sense it behind your eyes.
832-progress.title: Burning Shadows

840-accept.name: Takrin Pathseeker
840-accept.text:
Hmm, you look pretty strong.

Listen, my good friend Kargal needs some new recruits for Barrens duty. I know you want to do what's right for the Horde. Well, this is your chance.

Take this recruitment letter to Kargal and see if he'll sign it.
840-accept.title: Conscript of the Horde

840-complete.name: Kargal Battlescar
840-complete.text:
Oh, so Takrin sent you? He's an excellent scout, I'm not sure what I'd do without him.

I'll sign your recruitment letter, but what we really need is someone at the Crossroads.
840-complete.title: Conscript of the Horde

840-progress.name: Kargal Battlescar
840-progress.text: What do you want, pup? If you're not here for recruitment, I don't have time for you.
840-progress.title: Conscript of the Horde

842-accept.name: Kargal Battlescar
842-accept.text:
Take this signed recruitment letter to the Crossroads.

Sergra Darkthorn, curse her hide, is in charge there. She's a nasty shaman who will talk your head in circles before she lets you do anything useful. Thrall is convinced she's something special, but I'm not so sure.

You'll just have to decide for yourself, pup...
842-accept.title: Crossroads Conscription

842-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
842-complete.text:
Alright, $N. You want to earn your keep with the Horde? Well there's plenty to do here, so listen close and do what you're told.

 I see that look in your eyes, do not think I will tolerate any insolence. Thrall himself has declared the Hordes females to be on equal footing with you men. Disrespect me in the slightest, and you will know true pain.
842-complete.title: Crossroads Conscription

842-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
842-progress.text: Well well well, what do we have here? Has Kargal deemed me worthy of another recruit?
842-progress.title: Crossroads Conscription

844-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-accept.text:
Your first prey will be easy.

The plainstriders to the east have been harassing our food supplies and have become a nuisance.

Put down the plainstriders and return to me with their beaks.
844-accept.title: Plainstrider Menace

848-complete.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-complete.text:
Ah, yes.  These are good specimens.  Potent.

I am Forsaken, and we honor our contracts.  Here is your reward, $N.
848-complete.title: Fungal Spores

848-progress.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-progress.text: Do you have the spores, $N?  There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
848-progress.title: Fungal Spores

851-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
851-complete.text:
Very good.  You must have really stirred up those centaur -- our guards spotted activity down near the Stagnant Oasis, which was probably you.

You should be proud of your deed, $N.  There is much bravery in you.
851-complete.title: Verog the Dervish

852-accept.name: Regthar Deathgate
852-accept.text:
Hezrul Bloodmark is the leader of the Kolkar centaurs in the Barrens.  He is fierce, brutal and cunning.  Defeating him would disrupt and fracture the Kolkars, greatly reducing their threat to us.

So kill him.  As with Barak and Verog, bring me Hezrul's Head.

He leads his people from the Lushwater Oasis, to the south.
852-accept.title: Hezrul Bloodmark

852-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
852-complete.text: I commend you, $N.  These centaur are undisciplined and cannot focus their rage as the orcs can, but they are fierce nonetheless.  In defeating them, your valor is proven.
852-complete.title: Hezrul Bloodmark

855-complete.name: Regthar Deathgate
855-complete.text:
Nicely done.  I'm sure you've struck fear into the surviving centaurs, $N.  If they have sense, they'll now calm themselves and stop their advances.

But I don't think they will, and that is unfortunate.

Unfortunate...for them.
855-complete.title: Centaur Bracers

865-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-complete.text: Great, you got them!  Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...
865-complete.title: Raptor Horns

865-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-progress.text: Did you get the horns, $N?  Those things are going to make me a fortune!
865-progress.title: Raptor Horns

867-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-complete.text: Oh, these are nice. Real nice... Good job, $N. I look forward to seeing more of your work in the future.
867-complete.title: Harpy Raiders

867-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-progress.text: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.
867-progress.title: Harpy Raiders

869-accept.name: Gazrog
869-accept.text:
Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen from our guard tower.  It was meant as payroll to the Crossroads' guards, and we want that silver back.

The strange thing is... we caught one of the thieves on the night of the theft.  And... it was a raptor!  Unbelievable!

I don't know what raptors would want with silver.  But I don't care -- I want the raptors dead so they won't steal from us again!

Hunt raptors in the Barrens.  Collect for me their heads!
869-accept.title: Raptor Thieves

871-complete.name: Thork
871-complete.text: You have done well, $N. Those insolent quilboars will finally learn that the might of the Horde is not to be ignored.
871-complete.title: Disrupt the Attacks

872-accept.name: Thork
872-accept.text:
One of my scouts witnessed an attack on a caravan from Durotar, $N. The culprits are indeed the Razormane tribe of quilboars. One of the quilboars in particular is leading the raids: Kreenig Snarlsnout. He was seen northeast of here, just south of the road from Durotar. If the threat is to be ended, then Kreenig must die.

To be sure the attacks cease, though, I say we add insult to their injury. Kill Kreenig along with more of their tribe, and return to me when you have his tusk.
872-accept.title: The Disruption Ends

872-complete.name: Thork
872-complete.text:
Well done, $N. With Kreenig's death, there will be a definite decline in the attacks on our caravans.

Your people should be proud to count you among them.
872-complete.title: The Disruption Ends

872-progress.name: Thork
872-progress.text:
Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, $N. Learn this lesson well. It will aid you in the future.

The boars will flounder without direction, and we will be able to take back the Barrens.
872-progress.title: The Disruption Ends

875-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-accept.text:
Hahaha, $N. Back for more? Good, I like to hear that.

This time I want you to assassinate some of the harpy lieutenants in the Dry Hills. Only Witchwing Slayers can be lieutenants, and you can tell them apart by the rings they carry. They are a nasty bunch, but they lead some of the underlings in that area. Taking out 6 of them will be a decisive strike against their matriarchy.

Make sure they die painfully, $N. We want those harpy wenches to know the idiocy of picking fights with the Horde.
875-accept.title: Harpy Lieutenants

877-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
877-complete.text:
Your findings are amazing!  The seeds I gave you were dried, and dead.  Whatever rests under these oases can create life from nothing!

We must study this more...
877-complete.title: The Stagnant Oasis

878-accept.name: Mangletooth
878-accept.text:
You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.

If you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
878-accept.title: Tribes at War

880-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
880-accept.text:
Your findings are incredible, $N.  These oases hold properties that must come from an outside source.  Or perhaps an inside one.

I want to know how these fissures are affecting the beasts who drink from the oases' water.

Hunt oasis snapjaws at the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases.  Bring me their shells so I may examine them.
880-accept.title: Altered Beings

880-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
880-complete.text:
Thank you, $N.  Studying the beasts of an area can tell much about the area itself.  We shall see what tale these shells tell.

Please accept my gratitude for your aid ... and perhaps you can use these coins.  I find that I do not need them.
880-complete.title: Altered Beings

880-progress.name: Tonga Runetotem
880-progress.text: How goes your collection?  Did you get the shells?
880-progress.title: Altered Beings

881-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-complete.text:
You've beaten Echeyakee, and though his days of hunting are over... his spirit is with you.  He will show you the strength found in subtlety, and the honor in mercy.

Your path is still long, $c.  Let's hope you stride it well.
881-complete.title: Echeyakee

881-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-progress.text: The great cat calls to you, $N.
881-progress.title: Echeyakee

888-complete.name: Gazlowe
888-complete.text: It's a relief to get all this stuff back, so thanks for your help, $N. You know, I could use a $r like you to help out with my operation here. If you're ever looking for work, don't forget about how well Gazlowe pays for service!
888-complete.title: Stolen Booty

893-accept.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-accept.text:
The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.

If you wish to help bring honor to the Horde, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. That should do nicely!
893-accept.title: Weapons of Choice

894-complete.name: Unknown
894-complete.text: A variety of buttons, levers and blinking lights are somewhat erratically arrayed on the face of the control console. A small gauge indicates that the apparatus is currently operating within optimal levels, and indicates that control valves one through three are currently open. There is a small keyhole set into the lower right side of the control panel.
894-complete.title: Samophlange

900-accept.name: Unknown
900-accept.text: The three control valves are currently opened. The various readings on the control panel lead you to presume that they must be shut off before the apparatus can be shut off.
900-accept.title: Samophlange

900-complete.name: Unknown
900-complete.text: The lights indicating the three control valves dim as they are shut off. Green lights slowly fade into yellow, and the switch controlling the apparatus is now moveable, with the valves closed, it can be turned off.
900-complete.title: Samophlange

901-accept.name: Unknown
901-accept.text: With the apparatus deactivated, the control panel can be opened up and the samophlange removed from the console. With everything else in place, all that is left is to acquire the key to unlock the console.
901-accept.title: Samophlange

901-complete.name: Unknown
901-complete.text: Turning the key in the lock, the control console unlocks. A red light at the top of the console turns off and all power drains from the terminal.
901-complete.title: Samophlange

901-progress.name: Unknown
901-progress.text: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
901-progress.title: Samophlange

902-accept.name: Unknown
902-accept.text: Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. A tug removes it from its housing.
902-accept.title: Samophlange

902-complete.name: Sputtervalve
902-complete.text:
This is... er... interesting... yes. I'll have it sent along to the Tinkers' Union headquarters in Undermine. I'm sure after some careful dissection and research, they'll be able to make some sense of it.

But, perhaps I'll have a little look myself first...
902-complete.title: Samophlange

902-progress.name: Sputtervalve
902-progress.text: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
902-progress.title: Samophlange

905-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
905-accept.text:
Now, $N, the hunt deepens.  Now you must defeat your prey, and then find your way to its lair.

Hunt the sunscale raptors to the south.  Slay them and remove the feathers they wear.  Place the feathers on the scytheclaw nests southwest of the Stagnant Oasis. Show their brethren you do not fear them!
905-accept.title: The Angry Scytheclaws

905-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
905-complete.text:
So you've been to the nests and placed the feathers of your prey within them.  That took a fair portion of courage, no doubt about it.

Do you feel a little tougher, $N?  Because you look tougher now then when you first came here.  I guess the Barrens is doing its job.
905-complete.title: The Angry Scytheclaws

914-accept.name: Nara Wildmane
914-accept.text:
The druids in the Wailing Caverns, the Druids of the Fang, are an aberration.  They were part of an order of noble druids whose plan was to heal the Barrens, but now seek to remake that land to match their own, twisted dreams.

The Druids of the Fang have four leaders, and each possesses a dream gem.  Even now their faces haunt me!  Defeat the leaders and bring me their gems, and the Barrens may again know peace.

Go, $N.  You will find them lurking deep within the Wailing Caverns.
914-accept.title: Leaders of the Fang

95314-progress.name: Carolai Anise
95314-progress.text: I trust you did not get lost?
95314-progress.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95495-progress.name: Walton
95495-progress.text: Greetings, $c. What brings you up to my property today?
95495-progress.title: The Hermit Tanner

95507-progress.name: Vrang Wildgore
95507-progress.text: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>
95507-progress.title: Vrang's Game

95621-progress.name: Walton
95621-progress.text:
The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.

I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
95621-progress.title: Trouble in the Valley

959-progress.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-progress.text:
The dockmaster has been on my case ever since Mad Magglish made off with that 99-year-old port. I guess that bottle was intended as a gift for Gazlowe from none other than Baron Revilgaz himself.

If you're brave enough and patient enough to seek out Mad Magglish and get that port back, I'll see to it you get a nice reward.
959-progress.title: Trouble at the Docks

962-accept.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-accept.text:
The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, $N. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken.

Recently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential.

Unfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.
962-accept.title: Serpentbloom

96898-progress.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
96898-progress.title: Remnants of War

97253-progress.name: Wrenix the Wretched
97253-progress.text: Not another word out of you until your pockets are jingling with metal!
97253-progress.title: Parts and Pieces

97558-progress.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-progress.text:
Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.

It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.

Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
97558-progress.title: Hides for the Forsaken

99142-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-progress.text: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
99142-progress.title: Tomb Weed

99156-progress.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-progress.text: Have you dealt with our little problem?
99156-progress.title: Rear Guard Patrol
